name: Plastic sheet and acrylic
summary: Clear and solid plastic sheet and film: acrylic, polycarbonate, HDPE, PVC and polythene sheeting.
uses: Windows and greenhouse panels that don’t shatter like glass
Covers for solar water heaters, stills and dehydrators
Rain shields and vapour barriers (polythene film)
Cutting boards, guards and waterproof boxes
identify: Shop sneeze guards, display cases, signs, light diffusers, skylights, greenhouse panels and the big clear panels behind TV and monitor screens; rolls of polythene at building sites. Polycarbonate bends without cracking, acrylic snaps, and HDPE feels waxy like a chopping board.
test: Bend a corner gently: polycarbonate flexes, acrylic cracks. Hold it to the light to check for crazing (fine cracks), which spreads under stress.

decay.note: Lasts indoors. Sunlight yellows and embrittles cheap plastic over a few years.
